items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: So one practice we do with the Improvisers Orchestra... Warren Smith is the drummer

ctx.x: I wrote that down, you said that somewhere. Can you expand on that?

Well every note contains every other note if you know about the overtones. Right? There is no note left out. Once you hit a sound all others will show up in the overtone spectrum. You can’t really hear them, but you can hear them in the timbre. All right. So anyone could play any other note to that, but depending where it sits in the overtone range it has to be dynamically softer or stronger you see. And then you will harmonize. So one practice we do with the Improvisers Orchestra, which by the way had its 74th…
